text:
anna: Heads-up — planning to enable the `per-tenant-batching` feature flag in prod tonight. Need a deploy owner and someone to run quick smoke checks. Target window 22:00 UTC.

raj: I can take the deploy at 22:00 UTC. Will do canary in eu-west1 first, then global if green.

marta: Thanks — what are the safe defaults you want for staged rollout? and what's the rollback play if something spikes?

anna: Default plan: start at 10% tenants, wait 10m, if SLOs OK -> 50% -> 90% -> 100%. Rollback: flip flag to `false` and force-evict caches, coordinate with oncall to revert any traffic routing.

sam: Add quick smoke checklist please — latency, error rate, token ops. Also run a small prompt suite against a few high-traffic tenants.

anna: Smoke checklist (short):
- run health queries against 3 tenants (US/EU/APAC)
- check 95th latency, 5xx rate, CPU/GPU stall metrics
- ensure prefix cache hit-rate doesn't drop >5%
- validate no model-variant fallbacks triggered.

raj: I'll run this set after canary deploy. Post results in this thread and ping @marta for review.

marta: If anything >2x baseline error or latency >SLO+200ms, rollback immediately. Also confirm deploy-bot snapshot before flip.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: deploy-per-tenant-batching -> start 2154322800 (22:00 UTC). Snapshot ID: snap-2026-03-17-215432.

anna: CLI to flip 10% (example):
```
redwood cfg set per-tenant-batching=on --env=prod --staged=10
# verify: redwood cfg get per-tenant-batching --env=prod
```

sam: Quick rollback command: `redwood cfg set per-tenant-batching=off --env=prod` — I'll keep it handy. Also prepping smoke script:
```bash
for t in tenant-a tenant-b tenant-c; do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" \
    "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?tenant=$t" -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq .status
done
```

raj: Will post canary metrics at +5m and +12m. If green, I'll start ramp.

marta: I can be on-call for the first 30m post-canary to verify dashboards and agree the ramp. If anything weird, +1 for immediate rollback.

anna: Awesome — status check timeline: canary start 22:00 -> canary metrics at 22:05 & 22:12 -> ramp decision 22:15. Please react with :thumbsup: if you're set.

raj: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

marta: :thumbsup:

anna: Thanks — I'll post a final reminder 10m before.
